description: Verify that DUT-emitted UDP datagrams have a Length field equal to 8 (header) + udpUserDataSize (RFC 768 'Fields' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
RFC 768 defines the UDP Length field as the total UDP-layer byte count: 8 octets of header + the payload. Wrong length corrupts framing and may cause receivers to truncate or drop the datagram.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpTriggerSendUdp request (udpUserDataSize = 8)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - Length field == 8 + 8 = 16   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries Length == 8 + udpUserDataSize.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_length — Length is not 8 + payload size (e.g. payload-only count, or includes IP header)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_wrong_length: DUT emitted UDP Length is not 8 + payload
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
